data.whisper: Nature's Unbridled Fury. Howling winds unveil hidden fears.
mysteries: The sky turns green. Birds fall from it. This is not ordinary weather.
A weatherman's tower, destroyed by lightning. His instruments still record, with no operator.
Lightning strikes the same spot every hour. When you approach, you see a silhouette inside it.
The storm forms words in the clouds. They speak your name and two others you know.
Lightning becomes a hand. The storm has a shape now — enormous, curious about your presence.
The sky opens. What stands inside the storm has been watching since before the Blighted Lands.

data.whisper: Where silence speaks, the eight-legged weaver plots.
mysteries: Webs across the path, thick as rope. Something large spun them in the night.
A merchant's cart caught in vast webbing. The merchant is gone. His goods hang wrapped in silk above.
A shrine to an eight-legged god. Worshippers kneel before it, unresponsive.
A cave entrance sealed with webs. Muffled sounds from within — breathing, many of them.
The Spider descends on a thread as thick as an arm. Her eyes reflect every face you have ever worn.
The web springs. She was never hunting prey. She was hunting fate. The final strand is yours.

data.whisper: The Conjunction of two realms begins where nature has a foothold.
mysteries: A Sage is trapped behind an obsidian tree. Only the song of a rare obsidian moth can free them.
A winding path beneath obsidian moths. Their songs are a hum of death.
The Sapling of an Obsidian Tree. Six woodland guardians attack anyone who approaches.
A kaleidoscopic rift in space hangs mid-air. Through it, one can see into the BEYOND.
A hunter and his son are found dismembered, obsidian fragments on their corpse.
A dense fog. Trees have turned obsidian. From the fog, a Myriad emerges. It roars before retreating.

mysteries: The river runs backwards here. A fish leaps from the current and speaks a name — yours.
A fisherman pulling in his nets. What he catches isn't fish. He won't say what it is.

The river swells and speaks. It has carried secrets for centuries. It offers a trade.

mysteries: Paw prints in the mud, circling an abandoned camp. Something hunts this stretch of road.

The Alpha appears on a ridge above you, enormous and silent.
The pack descends as one. The Alpha leads the charge. Fight or flee.

A village frozen in the mist. Its inhabitants stand still, eyes open but unseeing.
At the heart of the mist: a figure. It looks like someone you have lost. It beckons.
The mist solidifies. Reality fractures. You stand at the threshold of what lies beyond the veil.

The lost pets run wild, back toward the secret door to the lost realm.
A dark clearing. Any deals made here are bound by fate. The goblin offers a trade.

mysteries: The sea fog rolls inland, bringing the smell of salt and iron and memory.
A sailor washed ashore. She claims to have sailed past the edge of the world and returned.
A lighthouse, unmanned, still lit. Its beam passes through solid objects.
A vessel anchored offshore. No crew. Its hold is full of goods from a civilization that no longer exists.
The sea speaks — not with words but with images of what it holds beneath.
The storm comes from nowhere. Something enormous and patient breaks the surface.

data.whisper: Its peaks touch the clouds, its roots delve into the very heart of the earth.
mysteries: An old shepherd warns of a presence at the summit. No one who climbs returns unchanged.
A carved shrine halfway up the slope. Fresh offerings left today.
A climber frozen in fear on a ledge. He claims the mountain spoke to him.
The summit is ringed with ancient stones. In the centre, a sealed door vibrates with warmth.
The mountain's spirit appears — colossal, patient, ancient. It asks one question.
The seal is broken. Something vast awakens inside the mountain.

data.whisper: In the depths of the veil, where sight falters and reason wanes, lies a truth shrouded in whispers.
mysteries: Fog rolls in low, unnaturally. Voices drift through it — familiar names called from nowhere.
A wanderer emerges, confused. She's been gone three weeks; it felt like an hour.
The mist thickens. Landmarks shift. The same tree passes three times.
A village frozen in the mist. Its inhabitants stand still, eyes open but unseeing.
At the heart of the mist: a figure. It looks like someone you have lost. It beckons.
The mist solidifies. Reality fractures. You stand at the threshold of what lies beyond the veil.

data.whisper: Callous, cruel, awful, and long. Feasting far beyond its hunger.
mysteries: Scorched earth and shattered trees. Something massive dragged itself through here recently.
A rancher weeping over crushed livestock pens. The Wurm passed through before dawn.
A village emptied. The Wurm coils beneath the ruins, sleeping off a grotesque feast.
A failed knight — sole survivor of a hunting party. The Wurm's den is close.
The ground shudders. Below, an ancient heartbeat. The Wurm stirs in its burrow.
The Wurm erupts from the earth — vast, ancient, and furious. The sky dims as it rises.

data.whisper: Where silence speaks, the eight-legged weaver plots.

A cave entrance sealed with webs. Muffled sounds from within — breathing, many of them.
The Spider descends on a thread as thick as an arm. Her eyes reflect every face you have ever worn.
The web springs. She was never hunting prey. She was hunting fate. The final strand is yours.

data.whisper: Where silence speaks, the eight-legged weaver plots.
mysteries: Webs across the path, thick as rope. Something large spun them in the night.
A merchant's cart caught in vast webbing. The merchant is gone. His goods hang wrapped in silk above.
A shrine to an eight-legged god. Worshippers kneel before it, unresponsive.
A cave entrance sealed with webs. Muffled sounds from within — breathing, many of them.
The Spider descends on a thread as thick as an arm. Her eyes reflect every face you have ever worn.
The web springs. She was never hunting prey. She was hunting fate. The final strand is yours.

mysteries: A caravan reduced to bones. Their water was full. They died of something else entirely.
The sand shifts into patterns that mirror a face. It keeps changing, looking for the right one.
A buried city's peak emerges from the sand. Music plays within.
A man has stood in the open desert for three days without water. The desert feeds him.
The sand forms a doorway. Through it you can see the desert as it was before — an ocean.
The figure who heralds the new era stands at the sand's edge. They have been waiting for you.

The Sapling of an Obsidian Tree. Six woodland guardians attack anyone who approaches.
A kaleidoscopic rift in space hangs mid-air. Through it, one can see into the BEYOND.
A hunter and his son are found dismembered, obsidian fragments on their corpse.
A dense fog. Trees have turned obsidian. From the fog, a Myriad emerges. It roars before retreating.

data.whisper: Nature's Unbridled Fury. Howling winds unveil hidden fears.
mysteries: The sky turns green. Birds fall from it. This is not ordinary weather.
A weatherman's tower, destroyed by lightning. His instruments still record, with no operator.
Lightning strikes the same spot every hour. When you approach, you see a silhouette inside it.
The storm forms words in the clouds. They speak your name and two others you know.
Lightning becomes a hand. The storm has a shape now — enormous, curious about your presence.
The sky opens. What stands inside the storm has been watching since before the Blighted Lands.

data.whisper: In the depths of the veil, where sight falters and reason wanes, lies a truth shrouded in whispers.
mysteries: Fog rolls in low, unnaturally. Voices drift through it — familiar names called from nowhere.
A wanderer emerges, confused. She's been gone three weeks; it felt like an hour.
The mist thickens. Landmarks shift. The same tree passes three times.
A village frozen in the mist. Its inhabitants stand still, eyes open but unseeing.
At the heart of the mist: a figure. It looks like someone you have lost. It beckons.
The mist solidifies. Reality fractures. You stand at the threshold of what lies beyond the veil.

data.whisper: On toes it crept just out o'sight, the petty hoarder full o'spite.
mysteries: Weeping huntsman, cursing everyone. He is looking for his lost bloodhound.
A lost lad, full of stories. Claims a little old man called him into the woods.
A cloaked old man calls out, then is dragged into the ground.
The lost pets run wild, back toward the secret door to the lost realm.
A dark clearing. Any deals made here are bound by fate. The goblin offers a trade.
Suddenly dragged to the Realm of Lost Things. The Goblin gloats from atop his pile.

data.news: A child was found with no memory of their family.

data.whisper: A Figure of legend heralds a transformative era.
mysteries: A caravan reduced to bones. Their water was full. They died of something else entirely.
The sand shifts into patterns that mirror a face. It keeps changing, looking for the right one.
A buried city's peak emerges from the sand. Music plays within.
A man has stood in the open desert for three days without water. The desert feeds him.
The sand forms a doorway. Through it you can see the desert as it was before — an ocean.
The figure who heralds the new era stands at the sand's edge. They have been waiting for you.

data.desc: Grey ash covers everything. Each footstep sinks deep. The air is stale.

data.whisper: Callous, cruel, awful, and long. Feasting far beyond its hunger.
mysteries: Scorched earth and shattered trees. Something massive dragged itself through here recently.
A rancher weeping over crushed livestock pens. The Wurm passed through before dawn.
A village emptied. The Wurm coils beneath the ruins, sleeping off a grotesque feast.
A failed knight — sole survivor of a hunting party. The Wurm's den is close.
The ground shudders. Below, an ancient heartbeat. The Wurm stirs in its burrow.
The Wurm erupts from the earth — vast, ancient, and furious. The sky dims as it rises.

data.whisper: A symbol of life's inception. It meanders, concealing ancient secrets.
mysteries: The river runs backwards here. A fish leaps from the current and speaks a name — yours.
A fisherman pulling in his nets. What he catches isn't fish. He won't say what it is.
A raft of bodies floating downstream, uninjured. They breathe, but they don't wake.
A submerged ruin visible through clear water. Something moves through its halls.
The river swells and speaks. It has carried secrets for centuries. It offers a trade.
The source. Where the river begins, the Old World does not end. It still runs here.

data.whisper: Where silence speaks, the eight-legged weaver plots.
mysteries: Webs across the path, thick as rope. Something large spun them in the night.
A merchant's cart caught in vast webbing. The merchant is gone. His goods hang wrapped in silk above.
A shrine to an eight-legged god. Worshippers kneel before it, unresponsive.
A cave entrance sealed with webs. Muffled sounds from within — breathing, many of them.
The Spider descends on a thread as thick as an arm. Her eyes reflect every face you have ever worn.
The web springs. She was never hunting prey. She was hunting fate. The final strand is yours.

data.whisper: Callous, cruel, awful, and long. Feasting far beyond its hunger.
mysteries: Scorched earth and shattered trees. Something massive dragged itself through here recently.
A rancher weeping over crushed livestock pens. The Wurm passed through before dawn.
A village emptied. The Wurm coils beneath the ruins, sleeping off a grotesque feast.
A failed knight — sole survivor of a hunting party. The Wurm's den is close.
The ground shudders. Below, an ancient heartbeat. The Wurm stirs in its burrow.
The Wurm erupts from the earth — vast, ancient, and furious. The sky dims as it rises.

data.whisper: Below the pale moon, the pack roams, driven by hunger that none can know.
mysteries: Paw prints in the mud, circling an abandoned camp. Something hunts this stretch of road.
A wounded traveler stumbles from the trees. The pack took his companions in the dead of night.
A child sits alone in a clearing, unharmed. The pack circles the treeline, watching.
A farmstead ravaged. Livestock gone. A carved bone left deliberately behind.
The Alpha appears on a ridge above you, enormous and silent.
The pack descends as one. The Alpha leads the charge. Fight or flee.

data.whisper: In the depths of the veil, where sight falters and reason wanes, lies a truth shrouded in whispers.
mysteries: Fog rolls in low, unnaturally. Voices drift through it — familiar names called from nowhere.
A wanderer emerges, confused. She's been gone three weeks; it felt like an hour.
The mist thickens. Landmarks shift. The same tree passes three times.
A village frozen in the mist. Its inhabitants stand still, eyes open but unseeing.
At the heart of the mist: a figure. It looks like someone you have lost. It beckons.
The mist solidifies. Reality fractures. You stand at the threshold of what lies beyond the veil.

Lightning becomes a hand. The storm has a shape now — enormous, curious about your presence.
The sky opens. What stands inside the storm has been watching since before the Blighted Lands.

data.whisper: Where silence speaks, the eight-legged weaver plots.
mysteries: Webs across the path, thick as rope. Something large spun them in the night.
A merchant's cart caught in vast webbing. The merchant is gone. His goods hang wrapped in silk above.
A shrine to an eight-legged god. Worshippers kneel before it, unresponsive.
A cave entrance sealed with webs. Muffled sounds from within — breathing, many of them.
The Spider descends on a thread as thick as an arm. Her eyes reflect every face you have ever worn.
The web springs. She was never hunting prey. She was hunting fate. The final strand is yours.

data.whisper: A symbol of life's inception. It meanders, concealing ancient secrets.
mysteries: The river runs backwards here. A fish leaps from the current and speaks a name — yours.
A fisherman pulling in his nets. What he catches isn't fish. He won't say what it is.
A raft of bodies floating downstream, uninjured. They breathe, but they don't wake.
A submerged ruin visible through clear water. Something moves through its halls.
The river swells and speaks. It has carried secrets for centuries. It offers a trade.
The source. Where the river begins, the Old World does not end. It still runs here.

The sand forms a doorway. Through it you can see the desert as it was before — an ocean.
The figure who heralds the new era stands at the sand's edge. They have been waiting for you.

currentAdaptiveChoices.title: Open a safe corridor for The Archive Keepers civilians
currentAdaptiveChoices.prompt: A frightened convoy is trapped between The Archive Keepers patrol doctrine and The Archive Keepers desperation. You can force a humane exit, but someone powerful will call it treason.
currentAdaptiveChoices.preview: Save lives, gain trust with The Archive Keepers, and strain ties with The Archive Keepers.
currentAdaptiveChoices.detail: You create a humanitarian corridor in defiance of a harder line. Survivors will remember who chose mercy over discipline.

currentAdaptiveChoices.title: Stage a public purge to break The Uprising resistance
currentAdaptiveChoices.prompt: A visible punishment will end sabotage for a season. It will also prove that you believe fear is more reliable than trust.
currentAdaptiveChoices.preview: Boost the hardliners, fracture civic trust, and move the world toward a harsher ending.
currentAdaptiveChoices.detail: You make an example of dissent. The sabotage slows, but the story of what you did spreads faster than the victory.

currentAdaptiveChoices.title: Carry the cursed proof out of The Uprising territory
currentAdaptiveChoices.prompt: The evidence that could unmake a faction is too dangerous for anyone else to bear. Take it yourself and live with what it does to you on the road.
currentAdaptiveChoices.preview: Advance the truth, lose comfort, and make your body the cost of revelation.
currentAdaptiveChoices.detail: You leave with the truth and the wound it causes. The revelation survives because you chose to carry it personally.

data.entrance: A librarian gargoyle stamps your wrist and points downward.
data.motif: Book-maze corridors with room numbers that refuse arithmetic
data.seal: The stacks only deepen after a floor contract is completed.

mood.resolution: Earn trust within the council. A traitor is suspected.

data.news: A stranger arrived three days ago and hasn't spoken since.

mapData.name: A ring of upright stones in perfect alignment

data.effect: Protected (Defend ↑ one Step)

data.desc: Pools of bubbling acid scar the earth. Nothing grows here — not even rot.

data.whisper: A Figure of legend heralds a transformative era.
mysteries: A caravan reduced to bones. Their water was full. They died of something else entirely.
The sand shifts into patterns that mirror a face. It keeps changing, looking for the right one.
A buried city's peak emerges from the sand. Music plays within.
A man has stood in the open desert for three days without water. The desert feeds him.
The sand forms a doorway. Through it you can see the desert as it was before — an ocean.
The figure who heralds the new era stands at the sand's edge. They have been waiting for you.

data.sage: A disgraced priest hiding from something in the capital
data.news: Strange lights in the hills at night have kept everyone inside.

data.buildingCondition: Choked with silt and mud — the lower floors are inaccessible.
data.buildingThis: A rustic mix of sculptures and public statement walls
data.buildingMade: Livingstone and frozen light — warm to the touch
data.buildingFor: An amusement park, or possibly a prison
data.buildingInside: Thick with the ghosts of destroyed objects, their shapes still faintly visible
data.buildingNow: Strewn with clues leading to a new traveling companion

data.condition: Inanimate. Nothing happens when you approach.

data.novelty: Floating hallucinogenic spores — Trauma Check required in Rooms 4–6
data.entrance: A door of solid iron with no handle — opens only from inside

data.nomad: A lone elder who claims to have seen the last Sovereign in this very spot
data.food: Hearty herbal stew and dark bread
data.news: Taxes were raised again. Someone will have to answer for this.

data.novelty: Perplexing Runes — no one can cast Scrolls inside
data.entrance: Marked with a fresh warning scratched into the stone: WRONG DIRECTION
An iron lift shaft hums with old power.
data.motif: Collapsed barracks beneath old roads
data.seal: Some chambers only yield to a spoken key.

data.whisper: Its peaks touch the clouds, its roots delve into the very heart of the earth.
mysteries: An old shepherd warns of a presence at the summit. No one who climbs returns unchanged.
A carved shrine halfway up the slope. Fresh offerings left today.
A climber frozen in fear on a ledge. He claims the mountain spoke to him.
The summit is ringed with ancient stones. In the centre, a sealed door vibrates with warmth.
The mountain's spirit appears — colossal, patient, ancient. It asks one question.
The seal is broken. Something vast awakens inside the mountain.

data.nomad: A family of eight who refuse to move south despite the danger
data.food: Fatty bread with honey and dried berries
data.news: A child was found with no memory of their family.

data.mood: Desecrated, its relics scattered and broken
data.sage: A sage who claims to be 300 years old and refuses to explain how
data.news: A traveling merchant claims the next Holding is abandoned.

data.whisper: Nature's Unbridled Fury. Howling winds unveil hidden fears.
mysteries: The sky turns green. Birds fall from it. This is not ordinary weather.
A weatherman's tower, destroyed by lightning. His instruments still record, with no operator.
Lightning strikes the same spot every hour. When you approach, you see a silhouette inside it.
The storm forms words in the clouds. They speak your name and two others you know.
Lightning becomes a hand. The storm has a shape now — enormous, curious about your presence.
The sky opens. What stands inside the storm has been watching since before the Blighted Lands.

data.whisper: Callous, cruel, awful, and long. Feasting far beyond its hunger.
mysteries: Scorched earth and shattered trees. Something massive dragged itself through here recently.
A rancher weeping over crushed livestock pens. The Wurm passed through before dawn.
A village emptied. The Wurm coils beneath the ruins, sleeping off a grotesque feast.
A failed knight — sole survivor of a hunting party. The Wurm's den is close.
The ground shudders. Below, an ancient heartbeat. The Wurm stirs in its burrow.
The Wurm erupts from the earth — vast, ancient, and furious. The sky dims as it rises.

data.symptom: Nausea and vomiting. −d4 to Body checks for 1 hour.
data.condition: Needs a key... oh... it's activating.
